scope: Required evidence for future domain adapters; no invented SQL columns, migration, permission or production approval

required_original_evidence.need: Owner-reviewed canonical CREATE/ALTER statements, migration/catalog lineage, exact deployed presence rules, keys, indexes, FKs and inventory. Field names must come from that source rather than a guessed adapter.

Authoritative installation, public/numeric key and row-version bindings, source/parent relationships, evidence and operation associations; rules for foreign installations and contradictory identities.
Original owner/write authority and deadline provenance. A download child deadline, receipt expiry, new worker claim or later observation cannot stand in for the original domain authority.

Defined terminal/nonterminal states and original timestamps, retention lower bounds, artifact/deletion states, holds, leases, cleanup and pending work, including how unknown or inconsistent values deny collection.

Complete incoming and outgoing use graph: logical references, retries, promotions and dependent tasks, evidence/audit/nonce references, foreign-schema FKs and program effects. An absent unimplemented table is not a no-reference proof.

Reviewed exact range/index predicates and global lock order under the original RR transaction; phantom protection and late recheck rules. No replacement transaction, renewed reservation, new authority or in-transaction LOCK TABLES callback.
Canonical positive expired terminal groups and active/held/leased/foreign/conflicting/late-reference controls in an exact owned SQL fixture, with original group and capacity restored on rejection.

Named owner review of the original schema/lifecycle/authority sources and their immutable hashes; separate actual protocol and physical-volume evidence. A digest by itself does not supply the missing semantics.

D_followup_after_sources_arrive: Implement the missing domain adapters with Early/Lock/Recheck on the original scope and transaction, retaining the reviewed canonical predicates and lock order.
Compose task, producer, catalog/import and direct-reference eligibility into the mandatory real Policy; deny missing or conflicting domain facts.

Add native regression controls and actual complete cold-group SQL cases, then submit the exact new source and raw outcomes to A. Existing synthetic task authority is not reused as real catalog approval.

current_local_candidate.domain_authority_in_cold_probe: explicit synthetic UID-scoped published task fixture
